시편-135-1.title: 시편 135장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-135-1.exegesis: 3. After the manner directed ( Nu 6:23 ). out of Zion-- the Church, as His residence, and thus seat of blessings. Thus close the songs of degrees.
시편-135-1.theologicalNote: 3. After the manner directed ( Nu 6:23 ). out of Zion-- the Church, as His residence, and thus seat of blessings. Thus close the songs of degrees.

시편-135-2.title: 시편 135장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-135-2.exegesis: PSALM 135 Psa 135:1-21 . A Psalm of praise, in which God's relations to His Church, His power in the natural world, and in delivering His people, are contrasted with the vanity of idols and idol-worship. 1-3. In the general call for praise, the priests, that stand in the house of the Lord, are specially mentioned.
